title: AssistanceMembership
description: Roadside assistance membership and what it entitles the member to. Distinct from the general Membership schema, which models a person belonging to a company or a project; this is a consumer entitlement against a service, read at intake so that entitlement is established before anyone is dispatched rather than asked of a driver at the roadside. Held in the eVault of the member.

memberEName.description: eName of the member: the person entitled to assistance

providerEName.description: eName of the assistance organisation. Foreign equivalents and car-brand assistance services use the same shape.

membershipNumber.description: Membership number as printed on the member's card

membershipType.description: Provider-specific tier name, for example basic, plus, abroad

coveredVehicleENames.description: Empty means the membership follows the person rather than a specific vehicle

roadsideAssistance.description: Covers a repair attempt at the roadside

recovery.description: Covers towing the vehicle away when it cannot be fixed on the spot

replacementTransport.description: Covers onward travel for the driver and passengers, such as a taxi or public transport

replacementVehicle.description: Covers a replacement car while the vehicle is being repaired

accommodation.description: Covers an overnight stay when the journey cannot continue the same day

abroadCover.description: Covers incidents outside the member's home country

repatriation.description: Covers bringing the vehicle back home from abroad

maxCallOutsPerYear.description: Maximum number of call-outs per membership year. Absent means unlimited.

callOutsUsed.description: Call-outs already used in the current membership year

entitlements.description: What the membership covers. An entitlement that is absent is not covered.

territory.description: Country codes the membership is valid in

validUntil.description: When the membership ends. Absent means it runs until cancelled.

status.description: Whether the membership can be used now. Only active entitles the member to assistance.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
